1.web: Of the blue, purple, and scarlet, they made finely worked garments, for ministering in the holy place, and made the holy garments for Aaron; as Yahweh commanded Moses.
1.asv: And of the blue, and purple, and scarlet, they made finely wrought garments, for ministering in the holy place, and made the holy garments for Aaron; as Jehovah commanded Moses.

2.web: He made the ephod of gold, blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen.
2.asv: And he made the ephod of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.

3.web: They beat the gold into thin plates, and cut it into wires, to work it in the blue, in the purple, in the scarlet, and in the fine linen, the work of the skillful workman.
3.asv: And they did beat the gold into thin plates, and cut it into wires, to work it in the blue, and in the purple, and in the scarlet, and in the fine linen, the work of the skilful workman.

4.web: They made shoulder straps for it, joined together. At the two ends it was joined together.
4.asv: They made shoulder-pieces for it, joined together; at the two ends was it joined together.

5.web: The skillfully woven band that was on it, with which to fasten it on, was of the same piece, like its work; of gold, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen; as Yahweh commanded Moses.
5.asv: And the skilfully woven band, that was upon it, wherewith to gird it on, was of the same piece and like the work thereof; of gold, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen; as Jehovah commanded Moses.

6.web: They worked the onyx stones, enclosed in settings of gold, engraved with the engravings of a signet, according to the names of the children of Israel.
6.asv: And they wrought the onyx stones, inclosed in settings of gold, graven with the engravings of a signet, according to the names of the children of Israel.

7.web: He put them on the shoulder straps of the ephod, to be stones of memorial for the children of Israel, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
7.asv: And he put them on the shoulder-pieces of the ephod, to be stones of memorial for the children of Israel; as Jehovah commanded Moses.

8.web: He made the breastplate, the work of a skillful workman, like the work of the ephod; of gold, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen.
8.asv: And he made the breastplate, the work of the skilful workman, like the work of the ephod; of gold, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.

9.web: It was square. They made the breastplate double. Its length was a span, and its breadth a span, being double.
9.asv: It was foursquare; they made the breastplate double: a span was the length thereof, and a span the breadth thereof, being double.

10.web: They set in it four rows of stones. A row of ruby, topaz, and beryl was the first row;
10.asv: And they set in it four rows of stones. A row of sardius, topaz, and carbuncle was the first row;

11.web: and the second row, a turquoise, a sapphire, and an emerald;
11.asv: and the second row, an emerald, a sapphire, and a diamond;

12.web: and the third row, a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;
12.asv: and the third row, a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;

13.web: and the fourth row, a chrysolite, an onyx, and a jasper. They were enclosed in gold settings.
13.asv: and the fourth row, a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper: they were inclosed in inclosings of gold in their settings.

14.web: The stones were according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names; like the engravings of a signet, everyone according to his name, for the twelve tribes.
14.asv: And the stones were according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names; like the engravings of a signet, every one according to his name, for the twelve tribes.

15.web: They made on the breastplate chains like cords, of braided work of pure gold.
15.asv: And they made upon the breastplate chains like cords, of wreathen work of pure gold.

16.web: They made two settings of gold, and two gold rings, and put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate.
16.asv: And they made two settings of gold, and two gold rings, and put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate.

17.web: They put the two braided chains of gold in the two rings at the ends of the breastplate.
17.asv: And they put the two wreathen chains of gold in the two rings at the ends of the breastplate.

18.web: The other two ends of the two braided chains they put on the two settings, and put them on the shoulder straps of the ephod, in its front.
18.asv: And the other two ends of the two wreathen chains they put on the two settings, and put them on the shoulder-pieces of the ephod, in the forepart thereof.

19.web: They made two rings of gold, and put them on the two ends of the breastplate, on its edge, which was toward the side of the ephod inward.
19.asv: And they made two rings of gold, and put them upon the two ends of the breastplate, upon the edge thereof, which was toward the side of the ephod inward.

20.web: They made two rings of gold, and put them on the two shoulder straps of the ephod underneath, in its front, close by its coupling, above the skillfully woven band of the ephod.
20.asv: And they made two rings of gold, and put them on the two shoulder-pieces of the ephod underneath, in the forepart thereof, close by the coupling thereof, above the skilfully woven band of the ephod.

21.web: They bound the breastplate by its rings to the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it might be on the skillfully woven band of the ephod, and that the breastplate might not come loose from the ephod, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
21.asv: And they did bind the breastplate by the rings thereof unto the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it might be upon the skilfully woven band of the ephod, and that the breastplate might not be loosed from the ephod; as Jehovah commanded Moses.

22.web: He made the robe of the ephod of woven work, all of blue.
22.asv: And he made the robe of the ephod of woven work, all of blue;

23.web: The opening of the robe in its midst was like the opening of a coat of mail, with a binding around its opening, that it should not be torn.
23.asv: and the hole of the robe in the midst thereof, as the hole of a coat of mail, with a binding round about the hole of it, that it should not be rent.

24.web: They made on the skirts of the robe pomegranates of blue, purple, scarlet, and twined linen.
24.asv: And they made upon the skirts of the robe pomegranates of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and twined linen.

25.web: They made bells of pure gold, and put the bells between the pomegranates around the skirts of the robe, between the pomegranates;
25.asv: And they made bells of pure gold, and put the bells between the pomegranates upon the skirts of the robe round about, between the pomegranates;

26.web: a bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate, around the skirts of the robe, to minister in, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
26.asv: a bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate, upon the skirts of the robe round about, to minister in; as Jehovah commanded Moses.

27.web: They made the coats of fine linen of woven work for Aaron, and for his sons,
27.asv: And they made the coats of fine linen of woven work for Aaron, and for his sons,

28.web: and the turban of fine linen, and the linen headbands of fine linen, and the linen breeches of fine twined linen,
28.asv: and the mitre of fine linen, and the goodly head-tires of fine linen, and the linen breeches of fine twined linen,

29.web: and the sash of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, the work of the embroiderer, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
29.asv: and the girdle of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, the work of the embroiderer; as Jehovah commanded Moses.

30.web: They made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold, and wrote on it a writing, like the engravings of a signet: “HOLY TO YAHWEH”.
30.asv: And they made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold, and wrote upon it a writing, like the engravings of a signet, HOLY TO JEHOVAH.

31.web: They tied to it a lace of blue, to fasten it on the turban above, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
31.asv: And they tied unto it a lace of blue, to fasten it upon the mitre above; as Jehovah commanded Moses.

32.web: Thus all the work of the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting was finished. The children of Israel did according to all that Yahweh commanded Moses; so they did.
32.asv: Thus was finished all the work of the tabernacle of the tent of meeting: and the children of Israel did according to all that Jehovah commanded Moses; so did they.

33.web: They brought the tabernacle to Moses, the tent, with all its furniture, its clasps, its boards, its bars, its pillars, its sockets,
33.asv: And they brought the tabernacle unto Moses, the Tent, and all its furniture, its clasps, its boards, its bars, and its pillars, and its sockets;

34.web: the covering of rams’ skins dyed red, the covering of sea cow hides, the veil of the screen,
34.asv: and the covering of rams’ skins dyed red, and the covering of sealskins, and the veil of the screen;

35.web: the ark of the testimony with its poles, the mercy seat,
35.asv: the ark of the testimony, and the staves thereof, and the mercy-seat;

36.web: the table, all its vessels, the show bread,
36.asv: the table, all the vessels thereof, and the showbread;

37.web: the pure lamp stand, its lamps, even the lamps to be set in order, all its vessels, the oil for the light,
37.asv: the pure candlestick, the lamps thereof, even the lamps to be set in order, and all the vessels thereof, and the oil for the light;

38.web: the golden altar, the anointing oil, the sweet incense, the screen for the door of the Tent,
38.asv: and the golden altar, and the anointing oil, and the sweet incense, and the screen for the door of the Tent;

39.web: the bronze altar, its grating of brass, its poles, all of its vessels, the basin and its base,
39.asv: the brazen altar, and its grating of brass, its staves, and all its vessels, the laver and its base;

40.web: the hangings of the court, its pillars, its sockets, the screen for the gate of the court, its cords, its pins, all the instruments of the service of the tabernacle, for the Tent of Meeting,
40.asv: the hangings of the court, its pillars, and its sockets, and the screen for the gate of the court, the cords thereof, and the pins thereof, and all the instruments of the service of the tabernacle, for the tent of meeting;

41.web: the finely worked garments for ministering in the holy place, the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest’s office.
41.asv: the finely wrought garments for ministering in the holy place, and the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest’s office.

42.web: According to all that Yahweh commanded Moses, so the children of Israel did all the work.
42.asv: According to all that Jehovah commanded Moses, so the children of Israel did all the work.

43.web: Moses saw all the work, and behold, they had done it as Yahweh had commanded, even so had they done it: and Moses blessed them.
43.asv: And Moses saw all the work, and, behold, they had done it; as Jehovah had commanded, even so had they done it: and Moses blessed them.
